dct_title_s: Sewage Collection System Sub-Basins - City of Newton
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer depicts the boundaries of the sewage collection system sub-basins in Newton. These sub-basins are roughly equivalent to watersheds.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to waste or sewage management, urban planning and related utilities purposes. More advanced user applications may focus on defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.
Supplemental information: The city does not maintain this data layer; it is unlikely that the boundary of a drainage sub-basin will change.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational, non-commercial use only.
Access constraints: Access is granted to licensee (Harvard University) only. Available only to Harvard University affiliates.
